description: A short cut between two boom-era towers, narrow enough that the wind funnels through hard enough to sting. Brushed-metal cladding sheets the walls, half of it peeled back to the rust beneath. Chrome Court's entrance stands at the far end — steel letters over the doors, three fallen and re-inked on cardboard — beside a solid brick of painted-over intercoms. The gutter runs with something that was recently oil.
name: Foundry Cut
